in_marathi.name: Avdhut
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Freedom from Avidya (ignorance)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avdhut हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avdhut is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Avidya', which signifies ignorance or false knowledge. Avdhut is the one who has attained the supreme knowledge and is free from the bondage of Avidya. In Hindu mythology, Avdhut is an epithet of Lord Shiva, who is believed to have attained this state of enlightenment.
